name: Earbuds Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an open orange earbud case whose two earbuds are its eyes, with a grin of little white charging lights
entry: It snaps its case shut on anything that gets too close and plays music into the ears of anyone who picks it up.
how: Use a Earbud Case on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Hyper Voice in this form.
